description: Separate the sandbox persistence mount from the checkout mount in `agro sandbox install`. userStories.notes: Guard at config.ts:74-90, reusing destroyConfirmationPhrase() + namedVolumes() exactly as lifecycle.ts:349 composes <project>_<volume>. --force per D-1, parsed at cli.ts:494-505.
